definitions.explanation: A series of large ocean waves typically caused by underwater earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, or landslides, capable of causing devastating destruction in coastal areas.

examples.japanese: {津波|つなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧！
{津波|つなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{襲|おそ}った→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: The tsunami hit the coastal town.

examples.japanese: {津波|つなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}たら→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{高台|たかだい}→高台：14683_takadai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}して→避難する：07908_hinan⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If a tsunami comes, please evacuate to higher ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{津波|つなみ}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A tsunami warning was issued after the large earthquake.

examples.japanese: 2011⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{東日本大震災|ひがしにほんだいしんさい}→東日本大震災：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{津波|つなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{太平洋|たいへいよう}→太平洋：09680_taiheiyou⟧⟦{沿岸|えんがん}→沿岸：13280_engan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{甚大|じんだい}な→甚大：17386_jindai⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もたらした→もたらす：10546_motarasu⟧。
examples.english: In the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake, a massive tsunami caused devastating damage across a wide area along the Pacific coast.

notes:
The Japanese word {津波|つなみ} has been adopted internationally as the standard term for this phenomenon. The kanji literally mean "harbor wave" ({津|つ} = harbor, ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧ = wave).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {津波|つなみ}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧ (tsunami warning)
- {津波|つなみ}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧ (tsunami advisory)
- {津波|つなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (a tsunami is coming)
- {津波|つなみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧ (to be hit by a tsunami)
- {津波|つなみ}⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧ (tsunami evacuation)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧ (earthquake)
- ⟦{高台|たかだい}→高台：14683_takadai⟧ (high ground)
- ⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧ (evacuation)
